text: Figure 4.10: SpecialData Class Sdg Package M2::MSR::AsamHdo::SpecialData Note Sdg (SpecialDataGroup) is a generic model which can be used to keep arbitrary information which is not explicitly modeled in the meta-model. Sdg can have various contents as defined by sdgContentsT ype. Special Data should only be used moderately since all elements should be defined in the meta-model. Thereby SDG should be considered as a temporary solution when no explicit model is available. If an sdg Caption is available, it is possible to establish a reference to the sdg structure.
